title: 12 Best Romantic Restaurants in Istanbul
description: Discover Istanbul's most romantic restaurants for an unforgettable date night. From Bosphorus views to historic charm, find the perfect spot for two in 2026.

places.name: Mikla Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Lamb Shank with Smoked Eggplant Puree and Crispy Phyllo, paired with a selection from their extensive wine list.

places.name: Nicole Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Opt for the chef's tasting menu to experience the full breadth of seasonal creativity, accompanied by Turkish wines.

places.name: Sunset Grill & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Chilean Sea Bass or their perfectly grilled steaks are renowned. Don't miss a cocktail from their stylish bar.

places.name: Çırağan Palace Tuğra Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Tuğra's Kuzu Tandır' (slow-cooked lamb shoulder) is a signature dish, a true taste of Ottoman luxury.

places.name: Mürver Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their grilled octopus or various cuts of dry-aged meats are highly recommended. Pair with a unique Turkish wine from their list.

places.name: Vogue Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The sushi platters are a standout, as are their grilled seafood options. Their cocktail menu is also quite impressive.

places.name: Neolokal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Go for one of the tasting menus (with or without wine pairing) to fully experience their philosophy and creativity.

places.name: Deraliye Terrace Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The Hünkar Beğendi (Sultan's Delight with slow-cooked lamb) or the Ottoman Lamb Stew are excellent choices.

places.name: Spago Istanbul
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their famous pizzas from the wood-fired oven or the pan-seared scallops. Don't forget their creative cocktail menu.

places.name: Frankie Istanbul
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their sea bass cooked in salt crust is a showstopper. Check their schedule for live music nights.

places.name: Balikci Sabahattin
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their fresh seasonal fish grilled to perfection, meze platters, and Rakı.

places.name: Seven Hills Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their breakfast spread is legendary for early risers, but for dinner, try their grilled fish or a traditional kebab while soaking in the illuminated landmarks.
